source.check: votes from the returning officer's notice (column 5), image-read; the same figures in the Irish News of 6 June 1964 p. 3

note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. All 23 divisions are taken from the returning officer's 'Notice of Result of Elections, 1964' (Eleanor Hollinger, returning officer, Clerk's Office, Rural District Council, Ballymena, dated 5 June 1964), printed in the Ballymena Observer of 11 June 1964, p. 2: candidates, votes where a poll was taken, persons elected and retired members deemed re-elected. Places of residence printed in the notice are not reproduced. No party labels are printed (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). The notice spells three divisions Glenraville, Glenwhirry and Tullaghgarley; the usual spellings are used here.
